name: MOSCAB Collaboration
notes: Roster and formation date not found. Status is unverified after June 2021.

summary.plain: The Italian-led group (INFN Milano-Bicocca, LNGS, Rome La Sapienza, ENEA and Valencia) that built the MOSCAB geyser-type bubble chamber for dark matter searches.
summary.technical: The 2017 detector paper is authored by 'The MOSCAB Collaboration' (spokesperson A. Pullia) from INFN Sezione di Milano Bicocca, Universitat Politecnica de Valencia, INFN LNGS, ENEA Casaccia, Sapienza Universita di Roma, Milano Bicocca departments and CERN.
